errors.text_span: The Level2 slice is colored medium light blue
errors.evidence: The Level2 slice (44.32%, left side) appears as a medium blue, not 'medium light blue.' The very pale/light blue is Level1. The description is somewhat imprecise in distinguishing the shades.
The white boundaries between slices appear thin, not thick. Describing them as 'thick' is an inaccurate characterization.
